clips.hook: I made the 94X call public. Now it is pumping again.
clips.caption:
An old time favorite is pumping like crazy again, and this one actually makes a lot of sense. Tutorial on BNB. You should have known it was coming, because I have been talking about this one the whole time, and I made it public when we did that 94X.

Then look at what came next. One week after that 94X, we did a 550X on another BNB play. September and October were absolutely insane, and this thing is 65x up from the bottom.

Holy crap, it feels good to actually see it pumping again. Holy guacamole, dude. And that is why this is the greatest crypto community on the planet.

Comment below and let me know: is altseason waking up?

clips.hook: The best meme on the Robinhood chain, without a doubt.
clips.caption:
In my opinion, what is the best meme on the Robinhood chain? I would, without a doubt, unequivocally, go for What If. What If is a concept. It is a beautiful phrase. I cannot believe that nobody ever thought of it before in a meme coin. What if this happens? I say it all the time. Everybody does.

Number two is Cooper, and the reason is simple: Cooper is a real dog. It is the office dog of Robinhood. It gives me that Toshi vibe, being the cat of Brian Armstrong. Here we have the office dog at the Robinhood headquarters. So cool.

Number three is Tendies. It is a very funny and stupid concept, and I think that is exactly what gets it a potential Robinhood app listing, just like fart coin. Number four is Yolo, because look at what it is doing: it pumped hard, and it is really maintaining that level. Maybe Swappy would be my number five.

Where would you rank them?

clips.hook: Binance says it wants community driven coins. Kaspa is not listed.
clips.caption:
Kaspa is a gem. Kaspa is the most beautiful thing ever. It is absolutely the most beautiful thing.

There was a blog article on the Binance website talking about how they are looking for community driven coins. Then Binance gives the argument about Neiro, that there is a community driven coin, but it is a meme coin.

They do not apply the same logic to Kaspa, because if they did, Kaspa would be listed on Binance by now.

So it is kind of a strange catch-22. How does that square?

clips.hook: That is the degen mindset. I do not trade like that.
clips.caption:
I am not looking at the short term. Like what is going to pump in the next two weeks, and what is going to pump and then die, and I am going to get out before it dies. That is the degen mindset. I do not really trade like that.

What I want are the tokens that get listed on all these centralized exchanges, become mainstream, and are already sitting there when retail starts coming back in and the bull run starts up again. I want to be in them before that crowd is looking at them.

Then one day I get to be like: holy crap, I was so freaking early. This particular token is at 700 million and I got in at 1.8 million. That is what I am looking for. I am not looking for the ones that are going to pump in two weeks and then die.

Which camp are you in?

clips.hook: doginme did 107 million once. Run that math again.
clips.caption:
I got some doginme. I got that dog in me. Right. I got that dog in me. It was the first dog on the Base chain to get listed on Coinbase.

The all time high of doginme is 107 million. I mean, is it not reasonable to get to 400 million in a really big bull run? Is it not reasonable? I do not know, I think so. And that means it is 100X from here. That means it is actually 100X, man. That is nuts. 100X from here. Craziness.

And what if doginme can survive to the next bull run and make it to something like an 800 million market cap, and we get a 200X?

Craziness, craziness, man. Good times ahead.

Now look at this, man. Look at, look at this. Look, look, holy crap.

We made that 94X call public when we did it. And then one week after that 94X, we did a 550X on another BNB play, again.

And that is why this is the greatest crypto community on the planet.
